# About Us

###### ABOUT US

### Welcome to H Jasvantrai Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

H. Jasvantrai Engineering Pvt. Ltd. (HJEPL) is a third-generation engineering company with a legacy of over seven decades in PHE (Plumbing, Heating & Engineering) and Fire Fighting contracting. The company has evolved steadily since its inception, combining technical excellence, integrity, and reliable service delivery.

###### History & Legacy

1955 – Founded by Mr. Jasvantrai Busa as S. Jasvantrai & Co., focusing on engineering excellence and trusted client relationships.

1980 – Leadership passed to Mr. Prakash Busa, who renamed it P. Jasvantrai & Co. after Mr. Jasvantrai’s retirement.

2004 – Mr. Hiren Busa assumed the role of Managing Director, driving exponential growth through adoption of modern technologies, expansion of service offerings, and entry into large-scale residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

2012 – Transitioned into a Private Limited entity as H. Jasvantrai Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

###### Mission & Values

HJEPL is committed to:

Delivering high-quality, compliant PHE & Fire Fighting engineering solutions

Upholding ethical business practices

Building long-term client relationships

Fostering professional excellence and modern business practices

###### Certifications & Memberships

ISO 9001:2008 certified

Upholding ethical business practices

Active member of the Liaison Plumbing Association

Holds PHE and Fire Fighting liaisons

###### Operations & Infrastructure

Centralized warehouse in Kalher, Thane (Mumbai) spanning approximately 6,000 sq. ft.

Own fleet of 2 vehicles for project material delivery

Workforce strength of 125 employees and over 550 qualified labour professionals

###### Expertise & Services

HJEPL delivers reliable, high-performance engineering solutions across diverse sectors, leveraging decades of experience, advanced technology, and a highly skilled workforce.

###### Managing Director of the Company

### Mr. Hiren Busa – Managing Director

Leadership with over 57 years of legacy.

##### MR. HIREN P. BUSA

Managing Director, H. Jasvantrai Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Mr. Hiren Busa, Managing Director of H. Jasvantrai Engineering Pvt. Ltd., represents the third generation of leadership and has been instrumental in steering the company through a sustained phase of growth and modernization. He is a B.Com graduate from the prestigious KC College, Churchgate Mumbai, and joined the family business in 1994, working closely with his father to gain in-depth, hands-on exposure to all aspects of Plumbing, Public Health Engineering (PHE), and Fire Fighting (FF) contracting works.

With over 30 years of professional experience, Mr. Busa brings a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic vision, and operational excellence. Under his leadership, HJEPL has successfully adopted modern engineering practices, advanced project management methodologies, and stringent quality and safety standards. He has played a pivotal role in expanding the company’s service portfolio, strengthening compliance with national and international codes, and building long-term relationships with leading corporate developers, consultants, Architecture and PMC’s.

Mr. Busa’s leadership philosophy is firmly rooted in quality, integrity, honesty, and hard work. He strongly believes that customer satisfaction creates a permanent impression and must always take precedence over short-term financial gains. This value-driven approach has been central to HJEPL’s reputation for reliability, ethical business practices, and consistent project delivery.
